postmortem_taxonomy_rule.variance_forcing_rule: When all pre-kickoff premises in a domain resolve SUPPORTED on their intermediate mechanism (e.g., Surtain/Hufanga out, SEA target share >= threshold, pressure rate >= threshold) but the final game score margin contradicts the directional lean due to turnover luck (fumble recovery rate != 50%, tipped-pass INT) or single-play special teams/defensive TD with |EPA| > 3.5, the postmortem MUST be classified as VARIANCE; post-hoc narrative invention is prohibited.
